final: WITH pa AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS pavg FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), ov AS (SELECT AVG(pavg) AS overall FROM pa), kept AS (SELECT pa.ID AS ID, pa.pavg AS pavg, pa.pavg - ov.overall AS diff FROM pa, ov WHERE pa.pavg > ov.overall), kavg AS (SELECT AVG(pavg) AS kavg FROM kept) SELECT kept.ID, kept.pavg, kept.diff, kept.pavg - kavg.kavg AS diff2 FROM kept, kavg WHERE kavg.kavg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff2 DESC LIMIT 10
